faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CMCH Coimbatore Field Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Field Assistant position at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital is 23rd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Field Assistant position, candidates must hold a graduate degree and possess basic computer knowledge. This ensures they can handle the data and tasks associated with the role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Field Assistant role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Field Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 17,500. This is a fixed consolidated pay for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Field Assistant position at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital. This is a single opening for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CMCH Coimbatore Field Assistant recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Field Assistant position. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt from paying a fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Assistant role primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the documents they submit.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Field Assistant position at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a specified period as per the contract terms.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Coimbatore Medical College Hospital, which is https://coimbatore.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for more information?
faq.answer: The official website for more information regarding this recruitment and other updates from Coimbatore Medical College Hospital is https://coimbatore.nic.in.
